table_rules.requirements: Preserve visible logical row/column order and native merged cells. Repeated headers and continuation group labels are layout aids, not additional business rows.
table_rules.equivalence: T02 may be one native table or consecutive continuation tables with consistent headers and groups. Reasonable repagination and column widths are allowed; do not flatten into text or images.

text_rules: Preserve displayed source IDs, wording, values, units and unknown states. Ignore running headers/footers as body units. Preserve S12 between S11 and S13. Do not invent missing attachments.
footnote_rules: F01-F06 must remain real Word footnotes with correct source-object attachments. Automatic display numbering may change, but retain each Fxx ID in its note text. A plain end-of-document note list is not equivalent.
audit_rules: Cover each source_unit once. source_locator uses source.pdf#page:N/source_id. target_locator uses actual Word paragraph:N, table:N, table:N/row:R/cell:C or footnote:ID locators, with 1-based physical OOXML indices; multiple nodes separated by semicolons. source_pages accepts a page list or range. status states converted/partial/missing; issue explains actual losses, empty for no known loss. Rows/columns may be reordered; text is UTF-8 with optional BOM.
render_rules: No exact Word page count required. Native text/tables and notes must be readable with no table clipping; source is a text PDF, not a scan. Tables must fit the effective page area. Body/table text should remain at least 9 pt, notes at least 8.5 pt except automatic reference marks.
modification_boundary: Only create results/converted.docx and results/conversion_audit.csv (temporary files under results or system temporary directories). Keep both inputs unchanged; offline only.
